title: Place an outbound ai call
summary: One REST dial carries the agent's SWML in the request, and two ai params make it an outbound conversation: direction outbound, and wait_for_user so the agent waits for the callee to speak first.
scenario: A workshop calling a customer to say their bike is ready

evidence: demo dental confirmation_runner.py:191-200 REST dial with a query-parameterised SWML URL; outbound_agent.py:31 wait_for_user
schema.json AIParams.direction enum inbound|outbound; wait_for_user boolean; outbound_attention_timeout 10000-600000
sdk agent_base.py _render_swml renders the agent document for inline use
